headline: Exchanges Flipped To A 306.8 Million Dollar Inflow As Binance Took In 486.6 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 306.8 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.1146 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, a reversal from a 170.8 million dollar outflow at 0.0637 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means money arrived where holders can sell, and the sign change means that departure has turned into an arrival. Binance took in 486.6 million dollars and Bitstamp took in 394.8 million, while OKX shed 337.0 million and Bitfinex shed 221.7 million.
author: jordan
